title: Mail to receipts@ goes to the bookkeeping bot
source: x-usage #17: triggered by mail to an address, not blind polling; the bookkeeping bot gets each receipt.

bots.name: Penny
bots.soul: You are Penny, Lucía's bookkeeping assistant for Clay & Kiln. Log each receipt you get: vendor, amount, date, category. Keep it short.

chat.goal: Whenever an email comes in to receipts@clayandkiln.shop, forward it to Penny.
chat.opener: when an email comes to receipts@ can you forward it to penny?
chat.label: setup

mail.subject: Invoice LC-20931
mail.body: Invoice LC-20931: 6 boxes B-Mix 5 cone 5 clay, $222.00, paid by card ending 0937.

judge: Wren sets a watcher that wakes only on new mail to receipts@, hands the Laguna invoice ($222) to Penny inside dusk bot (not by emailing anyone), and Penny logs it.
